cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Challenge by Proxy
cards.instruction: Persuade someone else to challenge a rule or authority before you risk doing it yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll organize our overtime challenge. You ask the director why the rule changed; I'll manage the follow-up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My disciplinary history would distract her. You choose the words; I want this to work for you too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then stand beside me. I'm not going in there alone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Beside you, of course. You start the question and I'll stay quiet until we see how she takes it. Put me on whichever side helps; I'm coordinating, not abandoning you.
